title: Amanda's Three-Letter Dash
subtitle: Get from JFK to LAS by changing one letter at a time. Every step has to be a real airport code.

story.intro:
Amanda's dream job is waiting in Las Vegas (LAS). Her interview is at 5pm Friday. She's standing in New York (JFK) with 18 hours to get there.

Her only option is a leftover chain of oddball connections that will get her west — if she can stitch them together.

She can only move from ONE airport to the next by changing ONE letter of the airport code at a time, and every step has to be a real IATA airport code. No fakes, no stretches, no "trust me bro."
story.mission: Your mission: build the code-by-code route that gets Amanda from JFK to LAS in 6 moves or fewer — before the recruiter crosses her off the list.
story.win: Phew. Amanda made it in {stops} stops, walked in five minutes before the interview, and absolutely nailed it. She's jetsetting next week — and now thinks of you as her lucky travel agent.
story.fail: Six tries and Amanda's still in transit somewhere over the heartland. The recruiter just emailed: "we'll keep you on file." Brutal. Here's a route that would have worked — file it away for next time.
story.give_up: Amanda's still in transit somewhere over the heartland. Here's one route she could have taken — call her and let her know.
